column1: # Code of others that the benchmark builds (build_tools.sh), fetched at these pinned versions; none of it
# is kept in this repository. version: the git commit, or the sha256 of the tarball.
# The MAW suite's repository also ships the sdsl-lite, libdivsufsort 2.0.1, pSAscan 0.1.0 and
# EM-SparsePhi 0.1.0 used to build MAW, pMAW and emMAW.
# Pinho et al.'s program cannot be downloaded: its site (ftp://www.ieeta.pt/~ap/maws, cited in the paper)
# is offline and unarchived. Armando J. Pinho has agreed (October 2026) that the original 2009 code be
# shared as part of this project: maws-2009-original.tar.gz is included at the path below.
